page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highcpu-16 is a compute-optimized virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9B45 processor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The instance is equipped with 30.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 1.88 GB of RAM per vCPU. This configuration does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. The CPU architecture is x86_64, supporting advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, AVX_VNNI, and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI.

Benchmark data indicates exceptional single-core capabilities. The server achieves top-tier performance in single-core CPU stress tests, single-threaded gzip compression, and single-threaded bzip3 decompression. Geekbench single-core and text processing metrics also rank in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-core performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations fall within the average range. Additionally, the processor demonstrates strong performance in image processing and text generation for small language models, though performance scales down to average levels for medium-sized models.

Given its high compute-to-memory ratio and lack of bundled local storage, the c4d-highcpu-16 offers a resource-dense profile optimized for CPU-bound tasks. It is highly cost-efficient for workloads that demand strong single-threaded execution without requiring massive memory footprints. Recommended workloads include single-threaded data processing, text and image manipulation, lightweight web serving, and small-scale machine learning inference.
